sentenceSets.sentence: Her assiduous attention to detail meant she rarely needed to correct her work after the fact.

answerChoices.reasoning: While 'careful' means taking care, the sentence emphasizes unremitting persistent attention ('assiduous'), not just careful work.
'Meticulous' means very precise and detailed; while her work is meticulous, 'assiduous' emphasizes the careful persistent effort over time.
'Diligent' means showing care in work; though closely related, 'assiduous' emphasizes the persistent unremitting nature more strongly.
'Thorough' means complete and careful; while her work is thorough, 'assiduous' emphasizes the persistent attention to detail.
'Precise' means exact; while her work is precise, 'assiduous' emphasizes the careful persistent effort.
'Conscientious' means wishing to do well; while she is conscientious, 'assiduous' emphasizes persistent unremitting attention.
'Attentive' means paying attention; while she is attentive, 'assiduous' emphasizes unremitting persistent effort.
'Painstaking' means taking great care; while her work is painstaking, 'assiduous' emphasizes the unremitting persistence.
Careless means not taking care; it contradicts the assiduous attention that prevented errors.
Hasty means done quickly without care; it contradicts the careful persistent attention the sentence describes.
Negligent means failing to give proper care; it contradicts the assiduous attention that prevented corrections.
